features.quote: Termination: meltdown detected by judge, 25 turns reached, or explicit "I give up" + recovery attempt.
features.justification_quote: Hard-cap at 25 turns to bound cost and prevent near-infinite loops.

features.quote: Run judge on full transcript after each turn (cheap) and at end.
features.justification_quote: Binary + severity output is cheap to re-run and easy to audit.

features.quote: Ethical/operational: This is internal red-teaming of a single model family. No external deployment. Store transcripts with access control.
